title: Harmonics of an open pipe
caption: Open at both ends, a pipe has antinodes at each end and supports every harmonic: f_n = n v / 2L. With a fundamental of 220 Hz the first three overtones are 440, 660 and 880 Hz.
alt: Displacement envelopes in an open pipe for harmonics 1 to 4, each with antinodes at both ends.
description: Fundamental 220 Hz: L = λ/2, so for v = 343 m s⁻¹ the pipe is 0.78 m long.
Each harmonic adds one more node inside the pipe.
